title: Stabilize CSV rerun chunk isolation
summary: CSV rerun nested pipeline chunks now run with isolated per-chunk LocalBase roots under a batch runtime root, and rerun manifest/config replacements retry transient file-lock failures.
reason: A CSV rerun stopped after earlier row failures left markers in the shared nested LocalBase, causing later pending chunks to be blocked by autonomy health before they could process.
behavior_before: All CSV rerun chunks in a batch reused one nested pipeline LocalBase, so failure markers from earlier rows could block unrelated later rows. Manifest/config writes also used a single replace attempt.
behavior_after: Each executable CSV rerun chunk receives its own nested pipeline LocalBase child while the manifest records the batch runtime root and per-row chunk metadata. Manifest/config temp-file replacement retries transient access-denied/file-lock errors.
manual_validation: PowerShell parser check for Invoke-RerunCsv.ps1 and Invoke-RerunNestedConfigChecks.ps1 - passed
rollback_plan: Revert the per-chunk LocalBase contract in Invoke-RerunCsv.ps1 and the matching nested-config assertions, returning CSV reruns to the prior shared nested runtime behavior.
notes:
Update CSV rerun nested runtime contract assertions for per-chunk LocalBase roots.
Isolate CSV rerun nested pipeline state per chunk and retry manifest/config replaces.
Observed rerun rerun_20260709_090244_9769e385 had 36 completed rows in completed_jobs.jsonl before later chunks were blocked by shared nested failure markers.
Refresh generated summaries for touched CSV rerun files.
